content.title: Where Are the Ozark Mountains?
content.text: When you visit Branson, MO, you don’t want to miss the opportunity to explore one of the most beautiful areas: the Ozark Mountains! The Ozarks is a group of highlands that spans five different states. If you’re hoping to visit, you may be wondering, “Where are the Ozark Mountains?” and we’re here to explain it to you! What States Are the Ozark Mountains In? Many people ask where the Ozark Mountains are because they aren’t just in one state, they’re in five! While most of the mountains are in southern Missouri and northern Arkansas, they also stretch into Oklahoma, Kansas, and Illinois. Missouri is home to a majority of the Ozarks, including the Ozark Plateau. That’s why we recommend carving time out of your Branson trip to explore! Arkansas is home to the Ozark National Forest and the Arkansas River Valley. As for the smaller portions, some of the Ozarks stretch into the northeastern territories of Oklahoma and the southeastern fringe of Kansas. The Illinois Ozarks are made up of the Shawnee Hills. The Ozark Mountains spread from the central portion of Missouri to northern Arkansas. It’s hard to tell an exact start and end location because the mountains actually blend into the surrounding terrain. However, the core part of the region in Missouri and Arkansas is well-defined! What Can I Expect When I Visit the Branson Ozarks? Branson is located in the heart of the Ozark Mountains. It’s the perfect place to visit to experience the best that the mountain region has to offer. You’ll be close to three of the most popular lakes in the Ozarks, including Lake Taneycomo, Table Rock Lake, and Bull Shoals Lake. Whether you’re looking for beautiful views, incredible fishing opportunities, or exciting water activities, you’ll love exploring the lakes in Branson. We recommend spending a whole afternoon during your vacation out on the water. Rent a boat to fish and relax, or enjoy water sports like jet skiing or flyboarding! Would you rather explore the area on foot? Check out one of the many hikes in the Ozarks, like Table Rock Lakeshore Trail and the White River Valley Trail. No matter how you decide to enjoy the beauty of the Ozarks, you’ll fall in love with the views and adventure. The Ozark Mountains is a highland region with plateaus, rolling hills, and karst formations. It’s among the oldest mountain ranges on the planet! The mountains are known for their woodlands, water lands, and recreation destinations. You’ll have the opportunity to spot various wildlife throughout the region, including 58 different species of mammals and a variety of fish, amphibians, reptiles, and birds. Another part of what makes this region so special is its geological features, like its extensive cave system. The Ozark Mountains truly are an outdoor lover’s dream! The next time you’re in Branson, MO, carve out some time to explore the Ozark Mountains! If you’re hoping to learn more about the area, check out these fun facts about the region.
